harness: Fresh agent session per run. Same model for every arm. Arm A: no skill. Arm B: the simple careful prompt below, no skill. Arm C: ShipRight installed (four skills + _shared). Optional arm D: ShipRight + one visual-craft pack. The agent never sees the reviewer criteria in README.md. No network beyond what the case needs, no installs, no edits outside a temp folder, no external actions.
